name: @midnight-examples/chain-config
description: ISOMORPHIC chain configuration primitives: network ids, endpoint defaults and the MidnightNodeConfig shape. CRITICAL: this package MUST run unchanged in BOTH a browser bundle and Node. Zero runtime dependencies, no environment access, no Node builtin and no DOM global — that is the whole point of it existing, and it is what lets a UI and a Node test harness share one source of truth.
